page-white.$description: Page White — Page canvas, card surfaces, input fills — the base everything sits on

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Body text, headings, nav links, border lines, icon strokes — the dominant structural color

hairline-gray.$description: Hairline Gray — Footer divider border — barely-there separator

input-border.$description: Input Border — Search input and form field borders

glitch-magenta.$description: Glitch Magenta — Pink accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

intervariable.$description: All text across the site — navigation, body, headings, dates, links. Inter Variable provides a neutral editorial voice that lets the artwork speak. Weight 400 carries body and meta, weight 600–700 carries titles and nav for confident hierarchy without serifs.
